profile.headline: Software Engineer Stf. at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: I am a software and systems engineer specializing in hardware/software integration, software development/testing, and technical project planning/leadership. I have experience owning high-stakes projects in dynamic environments. I have strong problem-solving and analytical skills as well as a talent for bringing clarity to complex initiatives.
